dataset: CMP validation pilot; not held-out test

production.mode: Native FP32 PyTorch CUDA, production PNG wrapper and default sharpening, no style finish

v3.mode: FP16 sequential CPU offload; no compositor, tinting or retouching

settings.prompt: Architectural facade surface, front elevation, wall finish matching the supplied material reference, clear glass within the marked windows, doors within marked door regions, realistic material texture, neutral diffuse light.
settings.negative_prompt: extra windows, extra doors, painted openings on a blank wall, plants added, trees, roof, street, people, cars, text, watermark, perspective, warped windows, blurry, drawing, cartoon

protocol.dataset: Original CMP, fixed stratified validation pilot
protocol.selection: Seed 42 SHA ordering, round-robin door-presence/window-count strata; selected before outputs
protocol.preprocessing: Shared facade bbox, neutral GT background, aspect-preserving 512 letterbox; valid rectangle scored
protocol.production_condition: Original CMP 12-class training LUT at native 256; native production sharpening on; styles off
protocol.v3_condition: Same annotation collapsed to semantic7 + explicit independent PBR material reference at 512
protocol.v3_status: SMOKE export selected step 0; V2 parent initialization, not quality-trained V3
protocol.metrics_note: Validation previously used for model selection, not an independent test. Single fixed SD seed per image. No FID on this small pilot; no generator IoU using the rejected teacher.
protocol.attribution: CMP Facade Database, Tylecek and Sara (2013), https://cmp.felk.cvut.cz/~tylecr1/facade/, CC BY-SA. Ground-truth comparison images retain this attribution.
